messages:
incident-bot: Paging oncall — elevated 5xx + 429s for org harborlytics. Spike started ~3725001200, current qps ~4.5k (baseline ~600). Error split: 429s (rate limit) + 503s (backend timeouts). Affected routes: /v1/generate (heavy batch), /v1/embeddings. Tagging #eng-oncall #cs. :warning:

alice_oncall: I'm on pager, looking. Any recent deploys? :eyes:

sam_sre: no deploys in last 2h. I'm seeing burst of requests with identical prompt prefixes from a small set of API keys. Likely customer-side loop. Querying rate limiter logs now.

maya_eng: if it's repeated small prefixes, KV cache may be getting miss heavy. We should consider immediate org-level temp quota bump + circuit-breaker on batch endpoints to protect cluster.

jordan_cs: Jordan from CS — HarborLytics reports 30% of their requests failing, customers complaining. Severity: HIGH. They are a paid enterprise account.

lee_pm: Notifying AE and CS lead. Please confirm mitigation plan before overriding quotas.

alice_oncall: Plan: 1) Apply temporary +3x token qps quota for org harborlytics for 20m. 2) Add circuit-breaker to reject batch size > 5 on /v1/generate for that org. 3) Disable embeddings endpoint for that org if errors persist. 4) Rollback after 20m and validate.

sam_sre: I can run override. Command (internal):

```
# temp quota bump +3x for 20m
POST https://admin.internal/api/orgs/harborlytics/ratelimit/override
Headers: Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN
Body: {"qps_multiplier":3, "duration_minutes":20, "reason":"emergency-hotfix - automated spike"}
```

ryan_ops: I'll stage a circuit-breaker rule in the WAF routing table to reject any request with header `x-batch-size` > 5 from that org — will do a dry-run then enable.

deploy-bot: Deploy triggered: circuit-breaker-rule/harborlytics dry-run -> success

alice_oncall: Applying quota override now.

sam_sre: Done — override applied. Response: 200 OK. New effective QPS limit ~1800.

alice_oncall: Enabling circuit-breaker (reject) for x-batch-size>5 for harborlytics.

deploy-bot: circuit-breaker-rule/harborlytics -> enabled

jordan_cs: Customer updated: errors dropping, a few users still see failures but much better. :white_check_mark:

sam_sre: Metrics: 5xx went from ~12% -> 0.8% over last 3m. 429 rate down by 95%. QPS on cluster returning to baseline. Good signal.

maya_eng: Leaving embeddings disabled for the org for now to reduce backend pressure. Will re-enable after 20m if stable.

alice_oncall: Handoff to eng-oncall for 30m watch: @sam_sre please monitor traces and latencies. I'll open incident tracking and note timeline. Create postmortem if condition recurs.

lee_pm: AE looped in, CS will follow up with HarborLytics about recommended client-side rate smoothing. Also request for permanent quota review.

alice_oncall: Closing pager state: mitigation active, customer impact reduced to minor. Last check 3725001567. Will update incident doc.
